reason: _git_precondition omits the registration guard, but restore_target only mutates when already on a slice branch (entered earlier by a registered-worktree run) and enter_slice_branch rejects unregistered worktrees before any item body runs.
_basis does `value in {set of str}`; a YAML list or mapping is unhashable so it raises TypeError and aborts the report, contradicting the malformed-to-None contract, in newly added code.

tape_filtered does re-spell the membership test and read the literal param key against its own docstring, but the parity integration test guards drift; it is a DRY/docstring issue, not a behavior bug.
psycopg_pool.PoolTimeout subclasses psycopg.OperationalError (MRO verified), so the existing except clause already catches it and maps to TickCalendarError (exit 4).
raw_counts bounds the scan by ts_event on a ts_event-chunked hypertable and the range join against an unnest array is speculative cost with no measurement; no demonstrated defect.
ProviderError subclasses only Exception (as do ModelResolutionError and ModelPoolNotImplemented), so reordering handlers cannot misroute; the remaining point is a missing usage=None test.
The claim is a function-size/DRY style point about run() duplicating the dispatch match; no behavioral defect.

raw_counts is unscoped by product so a second product's instruments would show as mismatches, but TICK_UNIVERSE holds only ES at head so it cannot occur yet (a later fix scopes it when the universe expands).
gaps.py still has its own window helpers (with a deliberately different half-open end convention documented there); duplication is a DRY/maintenance point and gaps.py is unchanged by the case.

The test asserts only success is False; on a 2-part failure the failed part has outputs={} so fold_review_parts raises TypeError, which the test masks, but that is a missing-assertion test weakness around largely pre-existing code.
strip_new_args hard-codes the replication host and the cutover scripts redeclare constants also in setup-backup.sh; a one-shot migration script with a define-once style violation, no defect.
Review.py now stamps a usage record per part, but _metadata copies only parts[0].metadata and sums only tool calls, so USAGE_KEY of parts 2..N is dropped and split-review spend is under-reported.
Running pyright on status_reads.py against the project's psycopg environment reports 0 errors, and trading-data's configured type checker is mypy, which does not enforce LiteralString.

resume_item catches only _Stop, GitEnvironmentError and OSError, so a ContextForgeError from evaluate_each_source or cf_client.list_slices escapes as a traceback (exit 1 = FLAGGED) instead of HALTED(3), a new failure path with no observable signal or test.
The cited def line is exactly 104 characters, within line-length 104; ruff check and ruff format --check both pass on executor.py.
The halted-item record is built with empty step results so branch is dropped, which is true, but it only loses a report field for a halted item whose reason already names the fault.

The run usage report iterates only persisted action_results, while _append_step serializes step_result.action_results and omits prior_rounds, and round_completed records nothing, so loop runs under-report totals.
compact's failure branch returns no metadata and compact() discards the captured reply telemetry if _reconnect raises, so spend is lost, contrary to D5 which dispatch/summary/review honor.

Pydantic validating `date | datetime` turns midnight datetime strings into date (verified: '2026-06-01T00:00:00Z' -> date(2026,6,1)), so resolve_window expands an explicit end timestamp to 23:59:59.999999 and drops offsets, in the new route.
